name: 🧠 Decision Log
description: "We decided X because Y." A log of the office's decisions with supersede chains — and a memory provider that puts the active ones in front of the agents you choose, on every turn.

commands.name: add
commands.desc: Record a decision and its reason

commands.name: supersede
commands.desc: Replace an earlier decision with a new one (the chain is kept)

commands.name: retire
commands.desc: Retire a decision without replacing it

commands.name: list
commands.desc: The active decisions (or every one, with the chain)
